title: Cube
body:
"Resizable cube schematic. It's, a cube, nothing special."

Description

The Cube is a schematic, purchasable for $180 at The Oak Depot. When placed, places a 1*1 stud cube that can be scaled, and like all schematics, can be filled with any material. However, it can also be resized into a rectangle.

Trivia

  • This schematic is always given when starting a new save file along with the Wedge, not in box form, but in the editor.
  • It has a scaling limit of 30 studs on all directions, just like all other schematics
